sources.quote: Iota Cancri, also named Yuyu, is a double star in the constellation Cancer.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 257 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,004 K, so 21.353 solar radii.

sources.quote: The brighter component is located at a distance of approximately 347 light-years (106 pc) from Earth based on parallax measurements, and is drifting further away with a line of sight velocity of 16 km/s.
